mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening that raises discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS has risen by at least 0.1% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that lowers corporate profit margins and investor confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a synchronized expansion in the housing and labor markets, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and PAYEMS have risen by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is compelled to accelerate monetary tightening, which increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which lowers corporate profits and investor sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below its 3-month moving average, it indicates a contraction in consumer spending that lowers corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 3mo_MA, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by at least 0.2% and PAYEMS falls by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO annual growth rate < 0.5%), the contraction in industrial output signals an impending economic deceleration, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO annual growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
